claim_ceiling: REPRODUCED — All three factory direction v29 tasks completed for TF-IDF family at 174k scale with frozen harness v3, seed=42, exact k-NN adversarial fix. Negative results honestly preserved. No further same-question cycle justified.
evidence_summary: Task 1 (174k formal suite): 8/8 TF-IDF reps PASS adversarial gates (lang_dom ~0.49-0.51, jurist_pref ~0.61-0.73) with HNSW fix; production default cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 strongest (0.4895, 0.7265). Two-mode tradeoff confirmed: citation-based PASS citation_heritage AUC (0.66-0.84) but FAIL hierarchy/cluster/boilerplate/cross-lang; text-based PASS adversarial but FAIL citation_heritage AUC. Task 2 (citation heritage): 2,019/2,105 citations resolved (95.9%); citation-based reps PASS AUC-ROC (0.66-0.84), text-based FAIL (0.50-0.64); ALL FAIL recall@10 (<0.01 vs 0.2) due to 0.1% graph coverage. Task 3 (v17b label norm): 85,819/173,963 labels normalized (49.3%); uniform_improvement=false; 4/8 reps degrade >10% on zoom_fine; no hierarchy/legal_area improvement. Additional: v18 coarse hierarchy NEGATIVE (branch max purity 0.6497 < 0.7); dense embeddings at 3yr and 2000-2015 ALL FAIL jurist gate (JP 0.008-0.045); universal FAILs on cross-lang retrieval, cluster coherence, hierarchy coherence, boilerplate resistance, legal area clustering. Evidence: REPRODUCED tier (frozen harness, seed=42, exact k-NN adversarial, preserved raw outputs).
